name: ai-proposal-writer-anna
tagline: Aetherion Labs — AI Proposal & RFP Studio 3.0: Voice-to-Proposal, 3-Pane Document Studio & RFP Shredder.
description:
AI Proposal Writer 3.0 is a next-generation AI Proposal Studio, RFP Intelligence, and Commercial Deal Workspace purpose-built for digital agencies, consultancies, freelance developers, and professional service teams.

Transform verbal ideas and multi-page client solicitations into high-converting, fully compliant proposals with Voice-to-Proposal (Web Speech API), a 3-Pane Document Studio, pre-built template blueprints, automated RFP requirements shredding, live 2-way compliance matrices, grounded company knowledge base, deterministic CPQ pricing, and multi-format exports (Microsoft Word .docx, Vector PDF, Markdown, and Pitch HTML).

### 3.0 Studio Transformation Capabilities

1. Voice-to-Proposal Studio:
- Speak naturally in English, Hindi, Hinglish, Tamil, or Urdu. Web Speech API live transcription extracts structured project scope, detects missing constraints, and drafts full proposals in seconds.

2. 3-Pane AI Proposal Studio:
- Professional document workstation featuring Collapsible Outline with drag-and-drop section reordering on the left, Rich Visual Document Canvas in the center, and Integrated AI Intelligence Studio Copilot on the right.

3. Pre-Engineered Template Blueprints:
- 8+ battle-tested architectures across Web Development, AI/Machine Learning Systems, Strategic IT Advisory, Digital Marketing, and Enterprise RFP responses.

4. AI RFP Shredder & Clause Extractor:
- Parses unstructured RFP documents (.txt, .md, .docx text extract, emails) to detect mandatory compliance language ('shall', 'must', 'will', technical constraints, deadlines, and evaluation criteria).

5. Live 2-Way RFP Compliance Matrix:
- Maps extracted requirements directly to proposal sections, flags coverage gaps, and enables 1-click 'Inject Compliance Clause' to eliminate disqualification risks. Export to CSV for audit reviews.

6. Company Knowledge Base & Context Grounder (Lightweight RAG):
- Stores verified agency case studies, security credentials (SOC2, HIPAA), team profiles, and standard warranties in local Anna Storage, grounding proposal generation in real facts.

7. Multi-Format Enterprise Export Suite:
- One-click native Microsoft Word (.docx) export with styled headings and tables, pixel-perfect Vector A4 PDF, GitHub-flavored Markdown, and standalone offline HTML presentations.

8. Interactive Client Presentation & Dynamic CPQ:
- Web presentation mode where clients can toggle optional service add-ons or tiers with immediate deterministic recalculation before digital sign-off.

9. Commercial Deal Pipeline & Kanban CRM:
- Visual Kanban deal stages (Drafting, Internal Review, Sent, Won/Accepted, Declined) with drag-and-drop status transitions.
